prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Write strict TypeScript module solution.ts and export the named function.
Required API: export function capPerKey(keys: readonly string[], limit: number): number[] | null
Behavior: Reject a negative limit. Otherwise return the original indices of at most the first limit occurrences of each exact key, preserving global input order. A zero limit or empty input succeeds with a non-null empty result.
Visible example: For keys ["a","b","a","a","b"] and limit 2, return indices [0,1,2,4].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: export function capPerKey(keys: readonly string[],limit: number): number[]|null {if(!Number.isInteger(limit)||limit<0)return null;const out:number[]=[],c=new Map<string,number>();keys.forEach((x,i)=>{const n=c.get(x)??0;if(n<limit)out.push(i);c.set(x,n+1)});return out}
